ControlTools.add_connector.description: Add a connector. config is what Claude Desktop runs, as its config file holds it: {"command": ..., "args": [...], "env": {...}} for a local server, or an npx mcp-remote command line for a remote one. Never write a secret the user has not given you: put ${CC_NEEDS:NAME} in its place, and the user fills it in in Connector Control. The connector goes into the active collection unless collection names another, switched on unless enabled is false.
ControlTools.apply_update.description: Apply the update waiting for a subscribed collection. get_pending_update shows what it changes.
ControlTools.argumentsNotObjectError: The arguments must be a JSON object.

ControlTools.changeActiveMessage.format: In “{0}”, the collection Claude is running:

ControlTools.changedWhileAskingError: This changed while Connector Control was asking, so nothing was done. Ask again.
ControlTools.check_tools.description: Whether npx, node, uvx and uv are installed where Claude can find them. A connector launched through a missing one shows only "server disconnected" in Claude.
ControlTools.configShapeError: A connector’s config needs a “command” or a “url”.
ControlTools.connectorsGroup: Connectors (the active collection unless --collection names another)
ControlTools.create_collection.descripti: Create an empty collection. It does not become active.
ControlTools.declinedError: You declined this change in Connector Control.

ControlTools.deleteActiveMessage.format: From “{0}”, the collection Claude is running. A copy remains in Backups.

ControlTools.deleteMessage.format: From “{0}”. A copy remains in Backups.

ControlTools.delete_collection.descripti: Delete a collection and its connectors. A copy remains in Connector Control's backups; a subscribed collection's file is left alone.
ControlTools.delete_connectors.descripti: Delete connectors. A copy remains in Connector Control's backups.

ControlTools.duplicateSubscribedError.format: “{0}” is subscribed; copy it in Connector Control with Make Local Copy.

ControlTools.duplicate_collection.descri: Copy a collection under a new name. The copy holds the same connectors, each on or off as it is, and does not become active. A subscribed collection is copied in Connector Control instead.
ControlTools.get_connector.description: Show one connector, with its secrets masked. Gives its command, arguments, URL and environment; environment and header values are never shown, only whether they are set. Looks in the active collection unless collection names another.
ControlTools.get_pending_update.descript: Show what an update to a subscribed collection would change. Names the connectors its file adds, deletes and changes; apply_update lands it.
ControlTools.get_settings.description: List Connector Control's settings and their values. The keys are the ones set_setting takes.
ControlTools.get_status.description: What Claude is running, and whether it needs a restart. Returns the active collection and how many of its connectors are on, whether Claude Desktop is running on an older config, whether Connector Control asks before Claude's changes, and where the master list is.
ControlTools.import_document.description: Copy the connectors in a collection file into a collection. They arrive switched off, with no link to the file afterwards. onClash says what to do with a name the collection already has: replace it, keep both, or skip it.
ControlTools.integrationOffError: Claude integration is turned off in Connector Control.
ControlTools.keepCountError: backups-to-keep takes a number from 5 to 100.
ControlTools.list_backups.description: List the backups of Claude's config. Each id can be given to restore_backup.
ControlTools.list_collections.descriptio: List collections. Each is a set of connectors and the active one is what Claude runs; a subscribed collection follows a file someone else publishes and is read-only.
ControlTools.list_connectors.description: List connectors and what each runs. Lists the active collection, the one Claude runs, unless collection names another. What each runs is a summary that never shows a secret.

ControlTools.needsValuesText.format: It needs a value for {0}: fill it in Connector Control.

ControlTools.noQuestionError: Connector Control couldn’t ask about this change, so nothing was done.
ControlTools.nothingToChangeError: Give a new config, a new name, or both.
ControlTools.queuedText: Waiting for another change in Connector Control to finish.
ControlTools.refresh_subscription.descri: Read a subscribed collection's file now. Says whether an update is waiting.
ControlTools.relaySummary: The relay Claude Desktop runs; not for direct use
ControlTools.restartToApplyText: Restart Claude to apply the change.
ControlTools.restart_claude.description: Quit and reopen Claude Desktop. The user is always asked first; the reply in progress stops and the conversation is kept.
ControlTools.restore_backup.description: Replace Claude's config with a backup. The current file is backed up first.

ControlTools.savedNotAppliedText.format: Saved, but Claude’s config wasn’t updated: {0}

ControlTools.set_connector_enabled.descr: Turn a connector on or off. Acts on the active collection, the one Claude runs, as Connector Control's own switches do; Claude picks the change up when it restarts.
ControlTools.set_setting.description: Change a setting. Takes a key from get_settings and on or off, or a number from 5 to 100 for backups-to-keep. Only the user can change claude-integration and confirm-claude-changes.

ControlTools.settingNotForClaudeError.format: Only you can change {0}, in Connector Control or with the command-line tool.

ControlTools.subscribe.description: Subscribe to a collection file someone publishes. It becomes a new, read-only collection that follows the file, and its connectors arrive switched off.
ControlTools.switch_collection.descripti: Make a collection active. Claude runs its connectors after its next restart.
ControlTools.update_connector.descriptio: Change a connector's config, its name, or both. config replaces the whole config; write ${CC_NEEDS:NAME} for any secret the user has not given you. Subscribed collections are read-only.
ControlTools.waitingText: Waiting for your answer in Connector Control.
